cohort: 188 patients diagnosed with NEC from 4 academic neonatal centers between January 1, 2011, and October 31, 2016
finding: Early-onset NEC and cesarean delivery were protective against the development of post-NEC stricture, while infants with post-NEC stricture had longer times to beginning enteral feeds and longer hospital stays.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was protective against the development of post-NEC stricture.
